decision.observation: Hornet is airborne in mid-jump at ~(0.56,0.47), cape spread, inside the green-lit opening. To her right a rocky ledge holds the banded pot-stones (~0.72,0.50), and above hangs a mossy rock overhang with dangling moss and stone slabs outlining the cave mouth (~0.45-0.75, 0.20-0.35).
decision.hypothesis: She is arcing toward the banded-stone ledge; continuing Right+Z should land her there, from which the mossy overhang above may be clingable — a route over the top of this chamber.
decision.memory: Green-lit opening with banded-stone ledge at right and mossy rock overhang above is the same dark-chamber cave mouth seen before; overhang cling is the next candidate.
